column1: # producer   by hand: Essenthos's versification rules, read by forge frame-files
# The psalms whose superscription the frame numbers as a verse of its own, verse 0 of the chapter: the chapters
# where a text that counts the title as a verse (BHSA, the Septuagint, the Vulgate and the texts that follow them)
# stands at the title. A translation that prints the title inside its first verse (texts/<SLUG>/titles) has that
# verse stand at the title too, in these psalms only. Read from the corpus of 2026-11-03 (64 chapters); frame-files
# warns when the frames it writes place a verse at the title of a psalm this list does not name, or name one none does.
# Columns, tab-separated: book (canonical ordinal), chapter (the frame's chapter)
